groups.name: PCI DSS — iface_1
groups.description: PCI DSS 11.4.5 (annual) / 11.4.6 (every 6 months, service providers) + CDE config review: every nmap check sent out of adapter {iface_1} toward cde_scope, non_cde_scope and out_of_scope. Expected: CDE <-> out_of_scope fully blocked (any open = 11.4.5 failure); CDE <-> non_cde_scope only approved ports (Req 1.2.5); same-zone and non_cde <-> out_of_scope = enumeration/evidence. Requires root or nmap raw-socket capabilities (-e, -sS, -sU).

items.name: iface_1: Source Segment Evidence
items.description: Record source IP, VLAN and routes of the test adapter. QSA evidence of where the test ran from.
items.command_template: ip -br addr show dev {iface_1}; ip route show dev {iface_1}; ip -d link show dev {iface_1} | grep -i vlan || true

items.name: iface_1 -> cde_scope: Host Discovery
items.description: Multi-probe discovery (ICMP echo/timestamp, TCP SYN/ACK, UDP). Sent via iface_1 toward CDE (stores/processes/transmits CHD + same-segment systems).

finding_template.title: PCI segmentation: iface_1 -> cde_scope reachable
finding_template.description: Traffic from the segment behind iface_1 reached CDE (stores/processes/transmits CHD + same-segment systems). Expected: CDE <-> out_of_scope fully blocked (any open = 11.4.5 failure); CDE <-> non_cde_scope only approved ports (Req 1.2.5); same-zone and non_cde <-> out_of_scope = enumeration/evidence.
finding_template.remediation: Compare with the approved flow matrix. Unapproved flow: deny it at the segmentation control (firewall/ACL/VLAN), re-test and keep the evidence. Approved flow: mark accepted.

groups.name: PCI CDE Asset Identification (Keywords)
groups.description: Scope confirmation (Req 12.5.2): find systems that look like they store/process/transmit CHD but are not in {cde_scope}. CDE = systems that store/process/transmit CHD/SAD + systems in the same segment. Connected-to / security-impacting = can reach the CDE or affect its security (AD, jump hosts, PAM, logging, AV, patching, NTP, DNS) — in scope. Out-of-scope = no access to CDE and no security impact. Keywords: pci, cde, card, cards, pan, pos, payment, payments, pay, checkout, cashier, kiosk, atm, hsm, token, tokenization, tokenizer, vault, acquirer, acquiring, issuer, merchant, settlement, billing, ecom, gateway, swift, 3ds, emv, terminal.

items.name: rDNS Hostname Keyword Sweep
items.description: Reverse-DNS list scan (no packets to targets) and flag hostnames containing CDE keywords.

groups.name: PCI CHD Discovery in non-CDE (Authenticated)
groups.description: Look for cardholder data outside the CDE (Req 3.2.1, 12.5.2). Spider only prints matching paths, but WARNING: if real PAN ever lands in Bars output/DB, Bars itself becomes in-scope — do not store PAN. Uses {username}/{password}.

items.name: SMB Share Name Keywords
items.description: List readable shares in the non-CDE range and flag share names containing CDE keywords.

items.name: CHD Filename Keyword Spider
items.description: Spider C$ for file/folder names suggesting CHD (needs local admin).
items.command_template: netexec smb {non_cde_scope} -u {username} -p {password} --spider C$ --depth 6 --only-files --exclude-dirs Windows,'Program Files','Program Files (x86)',ProgramData --pattern cardholder creditcard credit_card card_number cardnumber pan_ cvv track1 track2 pci payment

items.name: PAN Content Regex Spider
items.description: Spider C$ file contents for PAN-shaped numbers (Visa/MC/Amex/Discover). Matches need Luhn + manual validation.
items.command_template: netexec smb {non_cde_scope} -u {username} -p {password} --spider C$ --depth 6 --only-files --content --exclude-dirs Windows,'Program Files','Program Files (x86)',ProgramData --regex '\b(?:4\d{3}|5[1-5]\d{2}|2[2-7]\d{2}|6011|65\d{2})[ -]?\d{4}[ -]?\d{4}[ -]?\d{4}\b|\b3[47]\d{2}[ -]?\d{6}[ -]?\d{5}\b'
